notes: Fenwick (www.fenwick.co.uk, Shopify) is a multi-department store; scoped to the Home department ('Home & Tech' in the site's own taxonomy, same boundary used in the prior Home-Decor/Furniture pass for this SR). Checked: (1) Home & Tech mega-menu (52 /collections/home-and-tech-* links scraped from rendered homepage) -- no Bestsellers/Top-Sellers/Popular node anywhere in it. (2) Direct handle probing: /collections/bestsellers, /best-sellers, /top-sellers, /popular, /customer-favorites, /home-and-tech-best-sellers, /home-and-tech-bestsellers -- only /collections/best-sellers resolved (200), but its own H1/title is 'Fragrance Best Sellers' (Beauty/Fragrance department, not Home) -- excluded. (3) Site-wide /collections.json paged exhaustively (10 pages x 250 = 2500 collections covering the whole catalogue) grepped for bestsell*/best-sell* -- found: best-sellers (Fragrance, excluded), bestsellers-beauty, charlotte-tilbury-bestsellers, jo-malone-best-sellers, mens-best-sellers, kids-bestsellers, lego-bestsellers, offer-mens-bestsellers, polo-ralph-lauren-bestsellers (all other departments), furniture-bestsellers + garden-furniture-bestsellers (Furniture & Outdoor department -- out of scope, separately extracted elsewhere in this project), and homeware-bestsellers. Opened homeware-bestsellers (H1 'Homeware Bestsellers', a real small PLP, 6 unique products total via /products.json). Inspected every product_type in it: 3x Champagne & Sparkling (Food & Drink department), 1x Garden Furniture Set (Furniture & Outdoor department), 1x Pillows and 1x Tableware & Cutlery (the only two of the 6 actually inside Home & Tech). This is a small cross-department curated widget, not a Home-department bestsellers listing -- 4 of 6 items belong to other departments entirely and it cannot be cleanly isolated to Home & Tech, same 'mixed roll-up: drop, don't pad' logic the prior Home-Decor pass applied on this exact site to Tableware & Cutlery / Bedroom Accessories / Bathroom Accessories. Dropped rather than padded. No sort=best-selling query-string variant of a normal category page was counted as a distinct PLP (that's a sort option on the same collection, not a genuine separate Bestsellers merchandising page). Conclusion: no genuine Home-department Bestsellers PLP exists on this site.
